market.advice: Healthy, broadening tape into the open: SPY 747 holding above its 50-day (~744), only ~1.3% off highs, VIX 18 and falling, breadth 66% above the 50-day, just 1 distribution day. Leadership has rotated hard OUT of crowded mega-cap tech and INTO financials, REITs, healthcare, industrials, energy and utilities — that's the tell of a durable rally, not a fragile one. Offsetting risk: a live US-Iran conflict with oil up a 5th straight day and Red Sea/Hormuz shipping disruption, plus a fresh $1T defense bill. Net: normal position sizing, but buy the NEW leaders on pullbacks rather than chasing extended mega-cap names, and keep energy/defense exposure as a geopolitical hedge.

picks.thesis: NEW LISTING — SpaceX. Held by two users. The thesis is the business, not the chart: dominant global launch cadence (Falcon 9/Starship), Starlink's fast-scaling recurring revenue, and unmatched moat. But it's a freshly-public mega-cap IPO that's pulled back ~28% off its debut, RSI 18, and TV has no meaningful rating yet (screens STRONG_SELL on thin post-IPO data — expected). Treat quant signals as noise; own it as a long-term satellite/launch bet, sized small, and let the base form.
